text:
elaine: uploaded a compact mock for cohort compare + legend presets. core idea: small inline legend under the scrubber, presets for sampling (Smoothed 10%, Balanced 50%, Full 100%), and a tiny overlay toggle for p95 comparison. looking for quick UX + a11y calls.

rob: love the compactness. question: how do users know sampling is active? need a persistent pill near chart title showing current sample percent.

mason: agree. also prefer labels like 'Smoothed (10%)' so percent is explicit. interaction: if a user tweaks the slider after picking a preset, show 'Custom' state and a reset link.

elaine: good call. will show pill "Smoothed · 10%" and switch to "Custom · 23%" when changed. reset link next to pill.

a11y-bot: checklist: presets must be buttons with aria-pressed, slider exposes aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow, pill has aria-live updates on change, tooltip dismissible with ESC.

rob: legend: make it overlay on expand, not push layout. keep default minimal: color chip + short label. on expand show mute toggles per series. ensure touch targets are >=44px.

mason: visual cue: when overlayed p95 lines are active, dim heatmap to 40% and ensure p95 lines use solid vs dashed strokes and thicker width for visibility. also add pattern fill option for baseline when high-contrast mode on.

elaine: copy pass: sampling tooltip text: 'Sampling reduces plotted points to smooth noise. Raw stored metrics unchanged.' shorter: 'Visual only: smooth noisy signals; raw metrics intact.'

a11y-bot: keyboard flow to document for eng: tab to presets group, arrow keys to change, Enter applies, Tab to slider, arrows adjust percent, ESC closes tooltips, Shift+R resets to defaults. provide ARIA live region for percent updates.

rob: analytics: log sampling_preset_selected and sampling_custom_changed with anonymized cohort keys and percent. do not log raw metric values.

mason: one more microcopy: change overlay toggle text to 'Overlay p95' instead of 'Compare' to avoid ambiguity.

elaine: thanks all. action items: 1) add pill + reset link, 2) preset explicit percents, 3) custom state + toast, 4) dim heatmap on overlay + stroke variants + pattern in HC, 5) keyboard flow doc + aria-live, 6) analytics events anonymized. will push revised mock tomorrow. :sparkles:
